For all these reasons, we should read newspapers regularly. সংবাদপত্র পড়ার গুরম্নত্ব আমি খবরের কাগজ পড়ি।আমি মনে করি সবার জন্য সংবাদপত্র পড়া প্রয়োজন। কারণ সংবাদপত্র পড়ে আমরা বতর্মান বিশ্বের খবর জানতে পারি। আমি বাংলা ও ইংরেজি দুটো পত্রিকাই পড়ি। সংবাদপত্র পড়া আমাদের জ্ঞানকে সমৃদ্ধ করে। সংবাদপত্রকে বলা হয় জ্ঞানের ভান্ডার। এতে সারা বিশ্বের ঘটনাবলীর খবর থাকে। একটি সংবাদপত্র জীবনের বিভিন্ন ক্ষেত্রের খবর প্রকাশ করে। এটি রাজনীতি, অর্থনীতি, ব্যবসা,খেলাধুলা, সংস্কৃতি, সাহিত্য, প্রাকৃতিক দুযোর্গ, দুঘর্টনা ইত্যাদির উপর আলোকপাত করেতাই সংবাদপত্র পড়া অত্যন্ত্ম গুরম্নত্বপূণর্। একজন রাজনৈতিক নেতা বিশ্ব রাজনীতির খবর জানতে পারেন, একজন অর্থনীতিবিদ এবং ব্যবসায়ী যথাক্রমে বিশ্ব অর্থনীতি ও ব্যবসার খবর জানতে পারেন। একইভাবে আমরা সংবাদপত্রে আমাদের পি্রয়খবর এবং তথ্য খুঁজে পেতে পারি। আমরা সংবাদপত্র পড়ে নিজ নিজসেক্টর সম্পকের্ সচেতন হতে পারি। এই সমস্ত্মকারণে, আমাদের নিয়মিত সংবাদপত্র পড়া উচিত। A Visit to a Historical Place Man is not satisfied with what he has seen and known. A visit to a place of historical interest is really interesting and attractive. Dhaka is a place of historical interest. During the last summer vacation, I along with some of my friends, decided to go to Savar to see the National Memorial. Accordingly we fixed a date and started our journey from Gabtali to Savar at 10 a.m. by bus. We reached at the National Memorial just after 45 minute. Actually the National Memorial at Savar is the symbol of the nation’s respect for the martyrs of the war of liberation. It contains the history of our independence. It is built with concrete, but made of blood. It stands 150 feet tall. There is actually a series of 7 towers that rise by stages to a height of 150 feet. The foundation was laid on the first anniversary of the victory day. Reaching there we felt a great respect to the freedom fighters who sacrificed their valuable lives for us. We took some snaps taking the view of the memorial. However, we visited the place and the surrounding area for about an hour. The most moving sight of the complex is the several graves of the martyred freedom fighters just close to the tower. However, we left the place paying our glowing tribute to the freedom fighters. Through this visit we experienced a lot. একটি ঐতিহাসিক স্থান পরিদশর্ন মানুষ যাদেখেছে এবং জেনেছে তাতে সে সন্তুষ্ট নয়। ঐতিহাসিক আগ্রহের একটি স্থান পরিদশর্ন সত্যিই আকষর্ণীয় এবং আকষর্ণীয়। ঢাকা ঐতিহাসিক আগ্রহের জায়গা। গত গ্রীষ্মের ছুটিতে আমি আমার কয়েকজন বন্ধুকে নিয়ে সাভারে জাতীয়স্মৃতিসৌধ দেখতে যাওয়ার সিদ্ধান্ত্ম নিয়েছিলাম।েসই অনুযায়ী আমরা একটি তারিখ ঠিক করে সকাল ১০টায়বাসে করে গাবতলী থেকে সাভারের উদ্দেশ্যে যাত্রা শুরম্ন করি। আমরা ঠিক ৪৫ মিনিট পর জাতীয়স্মৃতিসৌধে পৌঁছলাম। আসলে সাভারে জাতীয়স্মৃতিসৌধ মুক্তিযুদ্ধের শহীদদের প্রতি জাতির শ্রদ্ধার প্রতীক। এতে রয়েছে আমাদের স্বাধীনতার ইতিহাস। এটি কংক্রিট দিয়ে তৈরি, তবে রক্তদিয়ে ৈতরি। এটি ১৫০ ফুট লম্বা। এখানে আসলে ৭ টাওয়ারের একটি সিরিজ রয়েছে যা ধাপে ধাপে ১৫০ ফুট উচ্চতায়উঠে যায়। বিজয়দিবসের প্রথম বাষির্কীতে ভিত্তিপ্রস্ত্মর স্থাপন করা হয়।সেখানে পৌঁছে আমরা আমাদের জন্য তাদের মূল্যবান জীবন উৎসগর্কারী মুক্তিযোদ্ধাদের প্রতি গভীর শ্রদ্ধা অনুভব করি। আমরা স্মৃতিসৌধের দৃশ্য গ্রহণ করে কিছু ছবি নিলাম। যাইহোক, আমরা প্রায়এক ঘন্টা জায়গা এবং আশেপাশের এলাকা পরিদশর্ন করেছি। কমপ্লেক্সের সবচেয়ে চমকপ্রদ দৃশ্য হল টাওয়ারের একেবারে কাছেই শহীদ মুক্তিযোদ্ধাদের কবর। যাইহোক, আমরা মুক্তিযোদ্ধাদের প্রতি আমাদের প্রদীপ্ত শ্রদ্ধা নিবেদন করে স্থান ত্যাগ করি। এই সফরের মাধ্যমে আমরা অনেক অভিজ্ঞতা লাভ করেছি। A Rickshaw Puller The man who pulls rickshaw for money is called a rickshaw puller. A rickshaw puller is a familiar person in cities and towns. He generally lives in a slum. Most of the rickshaw pullers have no rickshaws their own. They pull other rickshaws by renting. However, a rickshaw puller is a poor man. His dress is very shabby and dirty. His income is very low. He supports his family through much hardship. He works hard from morning till late night. He is seen carrying passengers in both good and bad weathers. He bargains with his passengers. He demands more when the weather is very hot and foul. Sometimes he tries to cheat passengers. But most often he is cheated by passengers. A rickshaw puller is seen sleeping on his rickshaw under a tree or sitting idly on his rickshaw. Though he drives rickshaw from morning till late night, he leads a very miserable life. His life is full of sorrows and sufferings. He cannot enjoy peace and happiness. If he becomes sick, he cannot drive his rickshaw. As a result, he and his family have to starve. Infact, the services of a rickshaw puller play an importance role in our national life. So we should think about his rights and show respect to them. একজন রিকশাচালক েযেলাক টাকার জন্য রিকশা চালায়তাকে বলা হয়রিকশাচালক। একজন রিকশাচালক শহর ও শহরে একজন পরিচিত ব্যক্তি। তিনি সাধারণত বস্ত্মিতে থাকেন। অধিকাংশ রিকশাচালকের নিজস্ব কোনো রিকশা েনই। তারা ভাড়া করে অন্য রিকশা টানে। তবে একজন রিকশাচালক গরিব মানুষ। তারেপাশাক খুবই জীণর্ এবংেনাংরা। তার আয়খুবই কম। অনেক কষ্টের মধ্যে দিয়ে তিনি সংসার চালান। তিনি সকালথেকে গভীর রাত পযর্ন্ত্ম পরিশ্রম করেন। তাকে ভালো এবং খারাপ উভয় আবহাওয়ায়যাত্রী বহন করতে েদখা যায়। তিনি তার যাত্রীদের সাথে দর কষাকষি করেন। আবহাওয়া খুব গরম এবং খারাপ হলে তিনি আরও বেশি দাবি করেন। মাঝে মাঝে তিনি যাত্রীদের ঠকানোর চেষ্টা করে। তবে প্রায়শই তিনি যাত্রীদের দ্বারা প্রতারিত হন। একজন রিকশাচালককে তার রিকশায়গাছের নিচে ঘুমাতে বা রিকশায়বসে থাকতে েদখা যায়। সকালথেকে গভীর রাত পযর্ন্ত্ম রিকশা চালালেও তিনি অত্যন্ত্ম দুবির্ষহ জীবনযাপন করেন। তার জীবন দুঃখ-কষ্টে পরিপূণর্। তিনি শান্ত্মি ও সুখ উপভোগ করতে পারে না। তিনি অসুস্থ হয়ে পড়লে তিনি রিকশা চালাতে পারেন না। ফলে তাকে ও তার পরিবারকে অনাহারে থাকতে হয়। প্রকৃতপক্ষে, একজন রিকশাচালকের সেবা আমাদের জাতীয়জীবনে একটি গুরম্নত্বপূণর্ ভূমিকা পালন করে। তাই আমাদের উচিত তার অধিকার সম্পকের্ চিন্ত্মা করা এবং তাদের প্রতি সম্মান প্রদশর্ন করা। Pahela Baishakh Pahela Baishakh is a part and parcel of Bangali culture. It is the first day of Bengali Calendar year. Our people observe this day with great festivities. The Baishakhi Mela which is celebrated this day is perhaps the largest festival of Bangali culture. People from all walks of life enjoy the festival in joyous mood. In villages, people pass the day meeting one another, giving and receiving invitations, enjoying music etc. by local performers and doing many other festive deeds. Businessmen open new books of account this very day which is known as Halkhata. Thus Pahela Baishakh comes every year with great joy and delight. Baishakhi Mela is a part and parcel of Bangali culture. It is perhaps the largest and most comprehensive celebration of the arts and culture of Bangladesh. It is held on the 1st day of the Bangla New Year. The Ramna Batamul is the centre around which New Year celebration has spread around the city and gradually across the country. This festival encompasses exhibition, music, poetry, crafts, photography, theatre etc in the urban area. A Baishakhi Mela is an annual gathering. Men, women and children gather in the Baishakhi Mela in large numbers. Fancy goods, toys, balloons, flutes, sweets and wooden things are mostly sold and children buy them. Circus parties are the common feature of the Baishakhi Mela. They often bring trained small tigers, elephants, monkeys, horses and bears that show funny feats. It is a matter of pride and pleasure that we celebrate our identity mature spirit through Baishakhi Mela. পহেলা ৈবশাখ পহেলা বৈশাখ বাঙালি সংস্কৃতির একটি অংশ। এটি বাংলা ক্যালেন্ডারে বছরের প্রথম দিন। আমাদের জনগণ এই দিনটিকে অত্যন্ত্ম আনন্দের সাথে পালন করে। এই দিনে পালিত ৈবশাখীমেলা সম্ভবত বাঙালি সংস্কৃতির সবচেয়ে বড় উৎসব। সবর্স্ত্মরের মানুষ আনন্দের সাথে উৎসব উপভোগ করেন। গ্রামগুলোতে লোকেরা একে অপরের সাথে দেখা করে, আমন্ত্রণ করে এবং গ্রহণ করে, স্থানীয়শিল্পীদের সঙ্গীত উপভোগ করে এবং অন্যান্য অনেক উত্‌সবপূণর্ কাজ করে। ব্যবসায়ীরা হালখাতা নামে পরিচিত হিসাবের নতুন খাতা খোলেন। এভাবে প্রতি বছর পহেলা বৈশাখ আসে মহা আনন্দ নিয়ে।ৈবশাখীমেলা বাঙালি সংস্কৃতির একটি অংশ। এটি বাংলাদেশের শিল্প ও সংস্কৃতির সবচেয়ে বড় এবং সবচেয়ে ব্যাপক উদযাপন। এটি বাংলা নববষের্র১ম দিনে অনুষ্ঠিত হয়। রমনা বটমূল হলেসইকেন্দ্র যার চারপাশে নববষর্ উদযাপন শহর এবং ধীরে ধীরে সারা দেশে ছডি় েয় পডে় ।এই উৎসবে শহর এলাকায় প্রদশর্নী, সঙ্গীত, কবিতা, কারম্নশিল্প, ফটোগ্রাফি, থিয়েটার ইত্যাদির আয়োজন হয়।একটি ৈবশাখীমেলা একটি বাষির্ক সমাবেশ। ৈবশাখীেমলায় নারী- ় পুরম্নষ ও শিশুরা বিপুল সংখ্যক ভিড জমায়। অভিনব জিনিসপত্র,েখলনা,বেলুন, বাঁশি, মিষ্টি এবং কাঠের জিনিস েবশির ভাগই বিক্রি ় হয়এবং শিশুরা কিনে েনয়। সাকার্স পাটির্ৈবশাখীেমলার সাধারণৈবশিষ্ট্য। তারা প্রশিক্ষিতেছাট বাঘ, হাতি, বানর,েঘাড া এবং ভালুক নিয়ে আসে যা মজার কৃতিত্ব েদখায়। এটা গবের্রও আনন্দের বিষয় েযৈবশাখীমেলার মাধ্যমে আমরা আমাদের পরিচয় পরিপক্ক েচতনা উদযাপন করছি। The International Mother Language Day The International Mother Language Day is an important day in the history of Bangladesh. Formerly it was known as 'Language Martyrs' Day', but now it has been recognized internationally as the 'International Mother Language Day' on 17 November, 1999 by UNESCO. At present, this day is observed all over the world to show love for mother tongue. In our country it is observed as a national mourning day. This is the day on which a lot of young Bengalis laid down their lives to uphold the right of their mother language. Salam, Barkat, Rafique, Zabbar including others were shot dead in the language movement procession against the illegal ruling party of Pakistan. Every year we observe the day with profound solemnity and great respect for the martyrs. Early in the morning the whole nation comes to the martyrs' monument to pay homage and due respect to the departed souls . People of all walks of life come here bare-footed in procession and offer flowers and wreaths to show honour to the martyrs. The people there keep silent for some minutes in honour and remembrance of the language martyrs. Government and non-government organizations arrange programmes to celebrate the day. Prayer is held in public prayer halls throughout the country for the salvation of the martyrs. This day inspire the people to love their mother language. We should do everything to save the honour of our mother language. আন্ত্মজাির্তক মাতৃভাষা দিবস আন্ত্মজাির্তক মাতৃভাষা দিবস বাংলাদেশের ইতিহাসে একটি গুরম্নত্বপূণর্ দিন।পূবের্ এিট 'ভাষা শহীদ দিবস'নামে পরিচিত ছিল, কিন্তু এখন এটি টঘঊঝঈঙ কতৃর্ক ১৭ নভেম্বর, ১৯৯৯ তারিখে 'আন্ত্মজাির্তক মাতৃভাষা দিবস' হিসাবে আন্ত্মজাির্তকভাবে স্বীকৃত হয়েছে। বতর্মানে সারা বিশ্বে মাতৃভাষার প্রতি ভালোবাসা জানাতে এই দিবসটি পালিত হয়। আমাদের দেশে এটি জাতীয় শোক দিবস হিসেবে পালন করা হয়। এটিেসই দিনযেদিন অনেক তরম্নণ বাঙালি তাদের মাতৃভাষার অধিকার সমুন্নত রাখতে প্রাণ দিয়েছিল। পাকিস্ত্মানের অবৈধ শাসকগোষ্ঠীর বিরম্নদ্ধে ভাষা আন্দোলনের মিছিলে সালাম, বরকত, রফিক, জব্বারসহ আরও কয়েকজনকে গুলি করে হত্যা করা হয়। প্রতি বছর আমরা শহীদদের প্রতি গভীর শ্রদ্ধা ও গভীর শ্রদ্ধার সাথে দিবসটি পালন করি। ভোরবেলা গোটা জাতি শহীদদের স্মৃতিস্ত্মম্ভে শ্রদ্ধা জানাতে ও বিদেহী আত্মার প্রতি শ্রদ্ধা জানাতে আসে। সবর্স্ত্মরের মানুষ এখানে মিছিলে খালি পায়ে আসে এবং শহীদদের প্রতি শ্রদ্ধা জানাতে ফুল ও পুষ্পস্ত্মবক অপর্ণ করে। ভাষা শহীদদের প্রতি শ্রদ্ধা ও স্মরণে কিছু মিনিট নীরবতা পালন করেন েসখানকার মানুষ। সরকারি-বেসরকারি প্রতিষ্ঠানগুলো দিবসটি উদযাপনে নানা কমর্সূচির আয়োজন করে। শহীদদের আত্মার মাগফেরাত কামনায় সারাদেশে সবর্সাধারণের নামাজ অনুষ্ঠিত হয়। এই দিনটি জনগণকে তাদের মাতৃভাষাকে ভালবাসতে অনুপ্রাণিত করে। মাতৃভাষার মযার্দা রক্ষায় সব কিছু করা উচিত। May Day Or International Workers' Day May 1st is internationally observed as May Day. It is also called the International Workers' Day. The day is observed to commemorate the historic struggle of working people. The day is observed in most of the countries of the world. The day has a historical background. At present, the workers enjoy some privileges such as minimum wages, safety laws and eight hours workday. All these came out for the sacrifice of the workers in 1886. From the beginning of Industrial Revolution, people worked very long shifts in factories. They had to work upto fourteen or even more hours a day. This is why, in the 1880s the workers called an eight hours’ workday movement. Workers of all classes joined the movement and called for a strike. On May 3, 1886 police fired on a crowd of strikers of the McComic Harvest Machine Company, Chicago. They killed at least one striker, five or six strikers were wounded seriously and an undetermined number of strikers were injured. If the workers did not stand up and demand their rights, they would continue to be exploited. So, the day is of much importance for the working people all around the world. েম দিবস বা আন্ত্মজাির্তক শ্রমিক দিবস ১লােম আন্ত্মজাির্তকভাবে মে দিবস হিসেবে পালন করা হয়। একে আন্ত্মজাির্তক শ্রমিক দিবসও বলা হয়। শ্রমজীবীমানুষের ঐতিহাসিক সংগ্রামের স্মরণে দিবসটি পালন করা হয়। বিশ্বের অধিকাংশ দেশে দিবসটি পালিত হয়। দিবসটির একটি ঐতিহাসিকেপ্রক্ষাপট রয়েছে। বতর্মানে, শ্রমিকরা ন্যূনতম মজুরি, নিরাপত্তাআইন এবং আট ঘণ্টা কমির্দবসের মতো কিছু সুবিধা ভোগ করে। এগুলো ১৮৮৬ সালে শ্রমিকদের আত্মত্যাগের জন্য েবরিয়ে এসেছিল। শিল্প বিপস্নবের শুরম্ন থেকে, লোকেরা কারখানায়দীঘর্ শিফটে কাজ করত। তাদের দিনে চৌদ্দ বা তারও বেশি ঘণ্টা কাজ করতে হতো। এই কারণেই, ১৮৮০-এর দশকে শ্রমিকরা আট ঘন্টা কমির্দবস আন্দোলনের ডাক েদয়। সকল েশ্রণীর শ্রমিকরা আন্দোলনে েযাগ েদয় এবং ধমর্ঘটের ডাক েদয়। ৩মে, ১৮৮৬ শিকাগোর ম্যাককমিক হারভেস্ট েমশিন েকাম্পানির স্ট্রাইকারদের ভিড়ের উপর পুলিশ গুলি চালায়। তারা কমপক্ষে একজন হরতালকারীকে হত্যা করে, পাঁচ বা ছয়জন হরতালকারী গুরম্নতরভাবে আহত হয় এবং অনিধাির্রত সংখ্যক হরতালকারী আহত হয়েছিল। শ্রমিকরা তাদের অধিকারের দাবিতে না দাঁড়ালে শোষিত হতেই থাকবে। তাই সারা বিশ্বের শ্রমজীবীমানুষের কাছে দিনটির গুরম্নত্ব অনেক েবশি। বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্য: নিচের এই প্যারাগ্রাফগুলোর অনুবাদ খুব শীঘ্রই আপডে করা হবে। Importance of Sports Sports are used as a metaphor for competitive struggle of life. They are also a great source of entertainment. They turn our monotonous life into a joyful one. Not too many things are so exciting in our life as sports. The importance of sports in our life is undeniable. Sports teach people life skills like teamwork, team spirit, leadership, patience and willpower. Additionally, sports teach accountability, dedication, and problem-solving skills. Sports boost self-esteem. Sports strengthen a body and make it active through exercise. We know, a sound mind lies in a sound body. Sports keep our body sound and mind cheerful. They also prevent various kinds of diseases. In this way, sports help us stay fit both mentally and physically. Our mind remains refreshed and we can have a healthy mind only when we have a healthy body. Great achievements come our way when we maintain our physical and mental well- being. The benefits of sports include improved heart condition, lower risks of stroke, diabetes and weight management, reduced blood pressure, stress relief, strong immune system and good sleep. Sports can also battle anxiety and depression. Again, a sports venue is a meeting place of different types of people. Thus, sports develop a sense of friendliness or brotherhood among people. Moreover, success in any sport is a source of national pride. It earns name and fame not only for a person but also for a nation. As the impact of sports on our life is paramount, we should engage ourselves in sports from our early life. Importance of Female Education Female education has now become a burning question in developing countries. We are the citizens of a civilized world. A nation can be powerful by educating all of her citizens. If the female education is neglected, a nation will not prosper. Education is a fundamental right of human beings. In the past, the rate of female education in our country was very low, but now it is increasing day by day. Still in our rural areas, the rate of this progress is insufficient. Here, due to social prejudice, many parents are reluctant to send their daughters to schools. Some parents marry them off before completing their secondary education. Early marriage, family restrictions, gender discrimination etc. are actively working as the main barriers to female education. Poverty, illiteracy, social prejudice etc. are the reasons behind it. However, we must not forget that every girl is a future mother and a child starts learning from its mother. Educated women can perform more important roles for the development of a country. So, their education is important. Government has taken a number of steps such as providing stipend, tiffin, learning materials etc. to ensure female education. Free education for girls up to their graduation has also been introduced. If it continues, the problems with female education will disappear. Importance of Moral Values Moral values are the principles and ethics that help human beings live a decent life. By following moral values, we live a life of virtue. They also help us live a life of righteousness and virtue. We feel glad when we are moral because we do not fear punishment and retribution for doing immoral acts. If we have moral values in us, we can also inspire others to lead a life of righteousness and virtue. The two major moral values are honesty and truthfulness. When we are honest and truthful, we can have a society free from corruption and violence. Consequently, peace will dominate in that society. Again, to respect other people, their views and opinions are also a type of moral value. If we want to live in peace, we must value others’ choices and opinions. Opinions and views may differ but we cannot engage ourselves in fight and quarrel regarding this. We should also do our duties that we have for our parents, family members, teachers, and the people of the society. More importantly, we have to love our country. We should not do anything that degrades or harms the honor of our country. In order to be an asset to the society as well as the country, we must realize the importance of moral values and sustain it in us. Significance of Liberation War The Liberation War bears a great significance in the history of Bangladesh because it marks the long struggle of the Bengali people for independence and self-determination. The oppressive rule imposed upon the Bengali people by the rulers of the then West Pakistan created a widespread discontent among them. So, they waged a nine month long bloody war against the oppressive rulers of Pakistan to get rid of the chains of oppression and exploitation. The war lasted for nine months and resulted in the birth of Bangladesh as a sovereign state. This great victory allowed the Bengali people to govern themselves according to their own will and aspirations. There were trails of destruction all over the country due to war. But the victory in the war emboldened the people of Bangladesh to rebuild the war torn country. It made them resolved to strive for a better future. The war instilled a sense of unity and patriotism among the people. It is also a symbol of resilience and courage for the future generations. The Liberation War will continue to remind the people of Bangladesh of the struggles and sacrifices of the freedom fighters, and thus make them learn to protest against oppression and injustice. The Significance of the Language or, Movement in Bangladesh The Language Movement of 1952 in Bangladesh holds profound significance. It is far beyond the defense of linguistic rights. That is why it laid the foundation for Bengali nationalism and the eventual emergence of an independent state. Initially, it was sparked by the Pakistani government’s attempt to impose Urdu as the only state language. Then, the movement quickly evolved into a symbol of cultural resistance and the demand for recognition of the Bengali identity. The deaths of student protesters on February 21, 1952, became a rallying point for unity across East Pakistan. It created a sense of solidarity that exceeded class and social divisions. The movement was success in making Bengali one of the state languages of Pakistan. It inspired greater political consciousness among Bengalis. They began to challenge the political, economic, and cultural dominance of West Pakistan. This struggle ultimately led to the independence of Bangladesh in 1971. It was recognized as the key turning point in the broader fight for self- determination. Today, it continues to be celebrated as a victory for language rights and as the birth of the nation’s journey toward freedom. The Significance of the Cultural or, Heritage of Bangladesh The cultural heritage of Bangladesh holds immense significance. It showcases the nation's rich history, diverse traditions, and strong identity. Rooted in a history spanning thousands of years, the country’s heritage reflects the influences of Buddhist, Hindu, and Muslim civilizations. The UNESCO World Heritage Sites like the ancient city of Bagerhat and the Buddhist Vihara at Paharpur symbolize Bangladesh’s architectural and religious depth. Traditional arts such as Nakshi Kantha (embroidered quilts), boat races, and the Baul folk songs preserve the spirit of rural life. Festivals like Pohela Boishakh, the Bengali New Year, Nabanna, etc. unite people across the country. They emphasize the cultural bond that links generations. These diverse elements of Bangladesh's cultural heritage not only foster national pride but also connect its people to their roots. It offers valuable insights into their history and way of life. Causes of Price Hike There are certain causes behind price hike in Bangladesh. The first and foremost cause is over population. Being a small country, it cannot produce enough food for its increasing population. Thus, inadequate agricultural output and inadequate industrial production are causing price hike. Another factor which causes price hike is less agricultural production due to natural disasters. Secondly, when syndicates of suppliers, sellers and extortionists decide to create a shortfall, price of commodities increases. When things are not supplied as per demand, their prices increase. Smuggling and black marketing are also responsible for price hike. Corruption of such levels go unpunished many times, which fuels the continuity of price-spiral. Thirdly, man-made crisis is another cause for the rise of the price of commodities. Some dishonest people store essential commodities with a view to making a huge profit. This causes a sharp decrease in the supply of commodities in the market, and as a result, prices increase. Moreover, the increasing of the prices of commodities also depends on international market. High-priced imports are also a prime cause of price spiral. Lastly, at present, anarchy and unawareness are also hugely responsible for increasing price of the commodities. Uses and Abuses of Facebook Facebook is arguably one of the greatest and the most wonderful inventions of modern technology. It is a social networking website intended to connect friends, family, and business associates. Users are able to search for friends and acquaintances by e- mail address, school, university, or just by typing a name or location for search. E-mail notifications let users know when new friends have chosen to add them to their list or when someone has sent a message to them within the system. A popular feature on Facebook is the ability to share photographs uploaded from a phone, camera, or hard drive. As with other private information, users have the option to allow only friends to see their pictures or anyone. There is an unlimited amount of storage available, which is a major advantage of Facebook’s photograph sharing capabilities. But it is now almost equally used and abused. Many young boys and girls become addicted to it and give more time on it than to studies. Again, sometimes privacy is not ensured. Few immoral people post obscene pictures. Seeing these pictures, the tender minds of the youngsters are severely damaged. A long term bad effect can be seen in those adolescents. Besides, various crimes are being committed through it. In fact, it gives us entertainment but it should not be turned into a national obsession encouraging narcissism. Despite these few bad sides of Facebook, it has great importance for communication in modern era. So, we all should take all possible steps so that this blessing may not turn into a curse. How to Prevent Heatstroke Heatstroke is a form of hyperthermia in which the body temperature is elevated dramatically. It usually occurs during extended heat waves, especially when they are accompanied by high humidity. Heatstroke results from prolonged exposure to high temperatures, usually in combination with dehydration, which leads to failure of the body's temperature control system. However, heatstroke is preventable. Several steps can be implemented to prevent heatstroke during hot weather. Firstly, maintaining proper hydration is essential. Secondly, we have to drink lots of water and refrain from drinking alcohol or caffeine, as they can lead to dehydration. Thirdly, to assist our body in regulating its temperature, it is important to wear lightweight, loose-fitting, and light-coloured clothes. Fourthly, to ensure comfort and safety, it is necessary to remain indoors during the highest temperature hours, usually from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. We have to utilize fans or air conditioning systems for a cooler environment. Fifthly, when spending time outside, it is crucial to take regular rest and refrain from engaging in physical labour. Besides we can use sunscreen to avoid sunburn, which may impede the body's capacity to regulate temperature. Finally, we have to identify the initial indications of heat exhaustion, such as heavy sweating, weakness, and lightheadedness, and take immediate action-resting and hydrating. By following these steps, we can easily prevent the risk of heatstroke. Environment Pollution The surrounding in which a person, animal or plant lives is called environment. There are many elements in our environment. Air, water, soil, plants, animals, etc. are such elements. They are essential for the environment as well as human beings. These elements should be sound for our sound living. But when they are polluted and their essential balance is disrupted, this phenomenon is known as environmental pollution. Nowadays, almost everywhere, our environment is being seriously polluted. In many places in our country, the environment has become extremely polluted. We are responsible for this severe pollution. Industries and factories emit a huge amount of smoke, gases and fume. Motor vehicles also emit a large amount of smoke and gases. All these pollute air seriously and polluted air is very harmful to us. Water is polluted due to the dumping of industrial wastes and by chemical fertilizers and insecticides which are washed away into rivers and canals. Due to the indiscriminate use of vehicle horns, loudspeakers, mikes, etc., the sound is polluted. Soil is polluted by harmful chemical fertilizers and insecticides. Besides, people are cutting down trees at random. All these are causing environmental pollution. Consequently, man becomes sick, the number of animals and fishes is decreasing, global warming is increasing, polar icecaps are melting, frequent floods are occurring and so on. We all should be aware of this harmful pollution and take effective measures to check it. Deforestation Deforestation refers to the cutting and burning down of forests at random. It is just the opposite of the concept of tree plantation. In a word, it is the destruction of trees and plants in our environment. It has many adverse effects on our environment and our life. It destroys the ecological balance of our environment and our life. Due to deforestation, many species of birds and animals have already been extinct and many of them are faced with the threat of extinction. Because of deforestation, it does not rain adequately and this causes long-term drought. This drought may turn the whole country into a desert. Apart from this, deforestation also hampers our agricultural production. In fact, our environment is going to be uninhabitable for deforestation. However, there is a way to save ourselves and our environment from it and that is, we should start a mass campaign for tree plantation. For this, we should raise awareness among the mass people about the adverse sides of deforestation as well as about the importance of tree plantation. My suggestion, in this regard, is that we should plant at least one tree every month and if we cut one, we should plant three. I think each man or woman, old or young should come forward and plant at least one tree to save our existence. Uses and Abuses of Mobile Phone We live in the age of science and technology. Mobile phone is one of the wonderful inventions of modern science and technology. Mobile phone is a scientific device by which we can communicate with others. This communication system is operated without any wire. We cannot imagine a day without mobile phone. Nowadays, especially the students are very prone to absorb the demerits of mobile phone. They sometimes keep chatting and wasting their time with their friends when they are supposed to be at their desk to study. Though people are getting benefits, mobile phone sometimes becomes the cause of health hazards. It causes brain tumours, genetic damage and many other health issues. But it is a matter of great regret that most people are not aware of the disadvantages of mobile phone. The blood pressure becomes high and red blood cells get damaged if a person is continuously exposed to radiation caused by cellular phone. Using cellular phone is also harmful for the pregnant women. So, the government should raise public awareness on using mobile phone by children and pregnant women. If mobile phone is used in a controlled way, it will do more benefit to us. Dengue Fever Dengue is a painful and debilitating mosquito-borne disease. It is borne by the Aedes mosquito. Tropical areas, like Indian Sub-continent, Southeast Asia, Southern China, Taiwan, the Pacific Islands, the Caribbean, Mexico, Africa, Central and South America are the most vulnerable areas of the world where Dengue Fever is likely to occur. Symptoms of Dengue usually begin four to six days after infection and last up to ten days. Symptoms may include sudden high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, severe joint and muscle pain, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, skin rash and mild bleeding. These symptoms may progress to massive bleeding, shock, and death. Unfortunately, till today, there is no specific treatment for dengue infection. Doctors generally suggest the infected people to take rest and drink plenty of fluids. One of the effective ways to prevent Dengue Fever is to prevent bites by infected mosquitoes. The best way to lessen the risk of Dengue infection is to reduce the production of Aedes mosquito. We can do that by taking effective measures such as keeping our living places and neighbourhoods clean. However, it is interesting to know that the Aedes mosquito requires just one teaspoon of water to lay its eggs and for the larvae to fully develop into adult mosquitoes. That is, it can practically breed in any place where clean stagnant water is available. So, we must not let water be clogged and accumulated so that Aedes mosquitoes cannot breed. A Rainy Day A rainy day is the day when it rains heavily or drizzles all day long. It is dull and gloomy. The sky remains overcast with black clouds. The sun is hardly visible. Gusty wind blows from all sides. Birds keep standing on branches of trees or keep quiet in their nests. Cattle remain in their sheds and bellow for the fodder. Water stands here and there. Unpitched roads become muddy and slippery. Passers-by have to walk with umbrella over their head, shoes in hand and pants folded up to the knee. Sometimes people slip and fall on the muddy road. In cities, a rainy day is now a horror. The roads and streets in some towns and cities get flooded. Vehicles are seen stranding in knee-deep water in some areas due to water clogging. It causes gridlock across the city. It is a day of trouble and annoyance to the office-going people. They have to suffer from various inconveniences. But for the school going children, it is a delight to have a rainy day. If it rains heavily before their school time, they get a holiday. Sometimes, children, especially the boys play football in the rainwater in the nearly fields. A rainy day is a curse for the poor. The day labourers cannot go out for work and hence, they have to suffer a lot. However, I pass the day by listening to music, watching TV or reading journals. In short, a rainy day is a day little of pleasure but lot pain.
